findings.issue: «desde» renders the prefixed מִן as a spatial or temporal starting point; with «temer» that can be read as origin rather than the person feared, while the token only marks from/of your God.

notes: Negation, piel 2ms, article-free singular adjectives, singular מִכְשֹׁל, 2ms suffix, Jehová, and the verbless אֲנִי יְהוָה are preserved.
